name: @taste-and-see/worker-identity-janitor
description: Identity janitor worker (TS-022-followup-3 + TS-023-followup-4). A separate long-running process that periodically prunes expired, retention-aged rows from the `identity` schema: `identity.refresh_tokens` (rotated/expired session tokens) and `identity.mfa_challenges` (consumed/expired MFA challenge rows). Both tables grow unbounded under sustained auth traffic and never shrink on their own; the janitor deletes rows whose `expires_at` is older than a configurable retention window (default 30d past expiry so audit trails are not immediately destroyed — CLAUDE.md §3.6). Deletes are batched to avoid long locks; the prune is idempotent and absolute-time-threshold based, so a missed cycle self-heals on the next tick.
